test_title: PYST 41: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All letters are message.

Some messages are emails.

No email is a post.

Conclusions:

(I) No letter is a post.

(II) Some emails are letters.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e530f9b466c818ec0a139c0821d67e17af49866b24e89111508ec39774ac0b8.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No letter is a post → Does not follow (As all letters are message, some messages are emails and no email is a post. As no direct relation is given between letters and post, therefore is false.)

(II) Some emails are letters → Does not follow (As all letters are message and some messages are emails. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
